name: ios-team
description: An agent team for an iOS repository (Tuist, Swift, SwiftUI) run by the main session: the lead coordinator protocol plus seven specialists (ios-engineer, architect, qa-tester, reviewer, analytics, wt-keeper, publisher), each on the model its job needs. Project values (schemes, test plans, bundle ids, repo, commit pattern) come from a local ~/.claude/ios-team/project.md. Every outward action waits for the developer's own word and a native permission dialog; never-list commands and secret reads are denied; simulators and worktree writes are leased between parallel sessions.
